title: KITY M3 frozen source contract probe
interpretation: Synthetic decile behavior is n//10: 30 gives 3/3 and 40 gives 4/4; frozen prose says 5/5 for the intended 50-name case.
The receipt function can emit PAPER_WEEK_OPERATIONAL_PASS for a synthetic six-leg filled list; this does not satisfy the prose 10-leg manager requirement and is not a live or canary result.
limitations: No raw HTTP OI or kline responses were obtained or saved; all responses were synthetic.
Static source review shows float conversion for lot and min-notional fields, zero defaults when filters are missing, and no explicit response provenance binding beyond saved-file hashes.
The existing signal cache is trusted verbatim, so stale or tampered JSON bypasses recomputation and validation.
No judge was run, no discovery archives were read, and no product files were edited.
